# This project checks its own Vue application against the portable Forge distribution.
# The source of truth stays here; regenerate workspace workflows with the CLI.
name: __FORGE_WEBVIEW_ID__ check
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: ['**', '/bin/**']
  pull_request:
    paths: ['**', '/bin/**']
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: __FORGE_WEBVIEW_ID__-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  check:
    name: Vue and Chromium (Node ${{ matrix.node }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        node: ['22.12.0', 24]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: ${{ env.FORGE_PROJECT_PATH }}/package-lock.json
      - name: Install locked dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Install Chromium
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Typecheck, unit tests, build and browser tests
        run: npm run check
      - name: Upload browser diagnostics
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: __FORGE_WEBVIEW_ID__-playwright-node-${{ matrix.node }}
          path: |
            ${{ env.FORGE_PROJECT_PATH }}/playwright-report/
            ${{ env.FORGE_PROJECT_PATH }}/test-results/
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7
